ideas.title: The Impact of Childcare Fraud on Minnesota Communities
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of childcare fraud on Minnesota communities, including financial losses and erosion of trust in social services.
questions: How many cases of childcare fraud have been reported in Minnesota?
What are the financial and social impacts on affected communities?
ideas.insight: This story could highlight the need for increased oversight and community engagement to prevent further abuse of childcare programs.

ideas.title: The Rise of Nonprofit Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the trend of nonprofit fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future case and its implications for the nonprofit sector.
questions: What are the common characteristics of nonprofit fraud cases in Minnesota?
How can nonprofits and regulators work together to prevent further abuse?
ideas.insight: This story could provide insights into the causes and consequences of nonprofit fraud, as well as potential solutions to prevent further abuse.
